description: This file defines the ProjectTask class, which represents a task within a project management module of SuiteCRM. The class includes properties for task details, relationships, and methods for managing task data, dependencies, hierarchical relations, and statistics within projects.

classes.name: ProjectTask
classes.description: Represents a project task entity with properties for task details, relationships, and methods for handling project task operations such as saving, updating, hierarchy management, and statistical calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ProjectTask, setting default values and assigning the current user or admin.

methods.name: skipParentUpdate
methods.description: Sets an internal flag to skip updating parent task percentage calculations during save.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides parent save to set project task ID during workflow and update project statistics.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the task's name for display purposes.

methods.name: _get_depends_on_name
methods.description: Fetches and returns the name of a task upon which this task depends.

methods.name: _get_project_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the project associated with the task.

methods.name: _get_parent_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the parent project for hierarchical display.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause for filtering tasks based on a search string.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if this bean implements a specific interface, such as 'ACL'.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides ACL-based permissions for list view display, controlling access to parent and parent task fields.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query to export project task data, including related user information.

methods.name: updateParentProjectTaskPercentage
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the percentage complete for a parent task based on its children.

methods.name: _calculateCompletePercent
methods.description: Calculates the overall completion percentage of a parent task based on its sub-tasks.

methods.name: getProjectTaskParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent project task based on parent_task_id and project_id.

methods.name: getAllSubProjectTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all child tasks under a given project task recursively.

methods.name: getNumberOfTasksInProject
methods.description: Helper method to count the total number of tasks within a project.

methods.name: updateStatistic
methods.description: Recalculates and updates project task completion percentages hierarchically.
